description: OF1 in current, in small: a fixed 6DOF hull (X 10 1, X 11 0 0 0 0 0 0, STL column through the rigid lid) and two rigid quasi-static nets (X 320 3 wall, X 320 2 cylinder) in a single-phase current (F 30 0, F 60 1.0 above the lid: water, W 22 0, B 60 1, B 61 1), N 40 4, laminar, 2 MPI ranks. The hull keeps the level set of its first cast (sixdof_obj_cfd::fb_unchanged), the net forces are reduced in one MPI_Allreduce per net and exchanged once for all nets.
